feeds.title: RuneScape News
feeds.description: Find the latest RuneScape news. Keep up to date with the community round-up, find out behind the scenes and new development information. RuneScape takes place in the world of Gielinor, a medieval fantasy realm divided into different kingdoms, regions, and cities. The game offers different types of monsters, resources, quests and magical spells to challenge players. The game's fictional universe has also been explored through the popular novels Betrayal at Falador and Return to Canifis.
